<description>
This doesn't fix the general case of rebroadcasting potentially surprising users by divulging the originator IP trivially, but for users opting into private broadcast, it seems a bridge too far for them to expect the current behavior.

e.g. an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet

This can be removed if/when wallet drives through private broadcast.

see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/3828 for running broader issue
</description>

<patch>
diff --git a/doc/release-notes-wallet-privbcast-resend.md b/doc/release-notes-wallet-privbcast-resend.md
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..0493cf1e77
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-wallet-privbcast-resend.md
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+Wallet
+------
+
+- With `-privatebroadcast`, the wallet's periodic resubmission of unconfirmed
+  transactions keeps them in the local mempool but no longer announces them to
+  peers. A transaction that was broadcast privately and later received back from
+  the network was otherwise announced again from the node's own connections,
+  which revealed its origin. (TODO: PR number)
diff --git a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
index 8e3079370f..4c20a4583b 100644
--- a/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/wallet.cpp
@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@
 #include <kernel/types.h>
 #include <key.h>
 #include <key_io.h>
+#include <net.h>
 #include <node/types.h>
 #include <outputtype.h>
 #include <policy/feerate.h>
@@ -1946,9 +1947,16 @@ void CWallet::ResubmitWalletTransactions(node::TxBroadcast broadcast_method, boo
 
 void MaybeResendWalletTxs(WalletContext& context)
 {
+    // With -privatebroadcast, a transaction may have left through a private broadcast and come
+    // back from the network. Announcing it again from this node's own connections, long after
+    // every other node went quiet about it, would mark it as this node's: keep it in the mempool
+    // without announcing it.
+    const auto broadcast_method{context.args->GetBoolArg("-privatebroadcast", DEFAULT_PRIVATE_BROADCAST)
+                                    ? node::TxBroadcast::MEMPOOL_NO_BROADCAST
+                                    : node::TxBroadcast::MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_TO_ALL};
     for (const std::shared_ptr<CWallet>& pwallet : GetWallets(context)) {
         if (!pwallet->ShouldResend()) continue;
-        pwallet->ResubmitWalletTransactions(node::TxBroadcast::MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_TO_ALL, /*force=*/false);
+        pwallet->ResubmitWalletTransactions(broadcast_method, /*force=*/false);
         pwallet->SetNextResend();
     }
 }
diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py b/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
index b72c79d362..4ece41eb63 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
@@ -157,6 +157,26 @@ class ResendWalletTransactionsTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
             node1.mockscheduler(60)
             peer.wait_for_broadcast([recv_wtxid])
 
+        self.log.info("With -privatebroadcast, resubmitted transactions are not announced")
+        node1.replace_in_config([("connect=0\n", "")])  # -privatebroadcast refuses -connect
+        self.restart_node(1, extra_args=["-privatebroadcast", "-onion=127.0.0.1:9", "-mempoolexpiry=1", f"-mocktime={node1.mocktime}"])  # the proxy is never used here
+        # Resending needs a recent tip (the restart put node1 back in IBD) and a block seen since startup
+        block = create_block(int(node1.getbestblockhash(), 16), height=node1.getblockcount() + 1, ntime=node1.mocktime)
+        block.solve()
+        node1.submitblock(block.serialize().hex())
+        node1.syncwithvalidationinterfacequeue()
+        peer = node1.add_p2p_connection(P2PTxInvStore())
+        # Expire the transaction so the resubmit visibly re-adds it
+        node1.bumpmocktime(2 * 60 * 60)
+        node1.sendtoaddress(node1.getnewaddress(), 1)
+        assert recv_txid not in node1.getrawmempool()
+        node1.bumpmocktime(RESEND_TIMER_LIMIT)
+        node1.mockscheduler(60)
+        self.wait_until(lambda: recv_txid in node1.getrawmempool())
+        node1.bumpmocktime(10 * 60)  # past the peer's announcement timer
+        peer.sync_with_ping()
+        assert int(recv_wtxid, 16) not in peer.get_invs()
+
 
 if __name__ == '__main__':
     ResendWalletTransactionsTest(__file__).main()

</patch>
